chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning's Nine-Nine Heavenly Tribulation - Desolate Era Chapter 510
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning's ascension to Celestial Immortal triggers a legendary Nine-Nine Lightning Tribulation. Can even his Innate spirit-treasure withstand the heavens' fury?
og_title: The Heavens Strike Back: Ji Ning Faces the Nine-Nine Tribulation
og_description: The dark clouds cover ten thousand miles as Ji Ning's greatest trial yet begins. His Ki Refiner body faces a tribulation reserved for monsters.
twitter_description: The Wind and Fire are mere preludes. Ji Ning’s Nine-Nine Lightning Tribulation signals the Heavens see him as a threat.

lore_anchors.definition: The magical treasure used as the core body for Ji Ning's second true body (Ki Refiner clone).
An Innate spirit-treasure seized from the Seamless Gate, capable of generating ice-elemental barriers and binding enemies.
A treasure born from the primordial energies of the universe, possessing a nascent spirit and immense power.
The final, dangerous stage of the Wind Tribulation; formless and bypasses physical defenses to attack the soul directly.
The most powerful and rare form of lightning tribulation for a Ki Refiner, consisting of 81 bolts of lightning.
Ji Ning's primary sword formation technique, powered by hundreds of Immortal-ranked flying swords and his Heartforce.
A metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power.
